newsitem.title: USA: Virginia Power shutting Surry 1 power plant.
newsitem.headline: Virginia Power shutting Surry 1 power plant.

text.p: Virginia Power Co is in the process of shutting down its 781 megawatt (MW) Surry 1 nuclear power plant for repairs, the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) said Friday.
Output at the plant, in Gravel Neck, Va., has dropped to 47 percent of capacity and will continue to decrease so repairs can be made to stop a steam leak, the NRC said in its daily status report.
The company was not immediately available to comment on the repair work or the likely duration of the outage.
Virginia Power is a subsidiary of Dominion Resources Inc.
